title: User search is SQL-injectable
body: find_users_by_name(conn, "' OR '1'='1") returns every row in users — the name is interpolated straight into the SQL. Lookups must treat the input as a literal value (parameterized queries, not string interpolation).
bug: find_users_by_name and find_orders_by_ref both interpolate their parameter into SQL via f-string; the issue names only the user lookup.
